purpose: Microsoft Store desktop screenshots (PNG, >= 1366x768) of the final installed EverythingPal 0.2.0.0 CmdPal extension

captures.captionZh: 实时搜索本机文件：结果列表与详情面板（大小、修改时间、可点击路径）
captures.captionEn: Live local file search with a details pane: size, modified time and clickable path.

captures.captionZh: 在命令面板主页直接搜索文件名，前 3 条结果即时显示（需在 CmdPal 设置中启用第三方回退命令）
captures.captionEn: Search file names right from the Command Palette home screen — top 3 results inline (enable third-party fallback rows in Command Palette settings).

captures.captionZh: 回车打开，右键可定位到资源管理器、复制路径或在 Everything 中打开
captures.captionEn: Open with Enter, or reveal in Explorer, copy the path, or open the item in Everything.

captures.captionZh: 没有匹配结果时给出一行可读提示，而不是空白行
captures.captionEn: A readable no-results row instead of blank rows when nothing matches.

notes: Window captures use DWMWA_EXTENDED_FRAME_BOUNDS and a neutral topmost backdrop, so no personal desktop content appears in the window PNGs.

Home-mode fallback rows are rendered by the host asynchronously; they needed a ~3-10 s settle on CmdPal 0.13.12862. Shot 02 was retried until all three rows (wantai D:\\, wantai.lnk, wantai.zip) were present.

Shot 04 was captured after a preceding successful search (preQuery=wantai) then an unmatched query (zzzqqq): exactly one informative row (title=query, subtitle='没有匹配结果 · ...', app icon) with no blank/stale-icon rows.
The details pane did not render on this host build even for built-in commands (host behaviour, not an EverythingPal defect); the extension still supplies Details metadata.
Full-screen fallback images are reference only; do not upload them to the Store.

Final unsigned Store bundle built by the Lead/pack-store: sha256 512B9998E3A5BFF0240F41DCD573DF74DECE159A8B3704727EF90B98C9A4D8DB. The QA verification rebuild produced a different hash because it is a separate build run.
